name: collectionReduce
description:
Iterates over every entry of the collection and calls the closure with every element. 
This function will reduce the array to a single value and will return the value.
syntax: collectionReduce( object collection, function closure, [object initialValue] )

params.name: closure
params.description: function/closure that implements the following constructor [function(... depending on the given collection ...):any].

params.name: initialValue
params.description: initial value passed as part of the first closure call
